text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE:- 1) TO BE INDUCTION HARDENED UPTO 45 ~ 55 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.6~ 2 mm AFTER FINISH GRINDING. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT 4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N4","page":1,"quote":"NOTE:- 1)TO BE TOUGHENED TO 28-30 HRc. 2)REMOVE ALL SHARP EDGES & CORNERS. 3)ALL KEYWAY ARE IN LINE & SHOULD BE DONE IN ONE SETTING. 4) STRAIGHTNESS:- 0.2mm/1000mm MAX. 5) RUNOUT:- 0.1mm/1000mm."}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '---' while notes N1 and N4 specify induction hardening, toughening to 28-30 HRc, and that case depth applies 'AFTER FINISH GRINDING'. Leaving the title block blank risks the shop missing the required treatments or applying them in the wrong sequence; the designer should fill the heat_treatment field with a reference to the applicable notes or summarize the required treatments and their stages.","recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field to reference the specified treatments (e.g., 'SEE NOTES N1 & N4') so they are not overlooked during manufacturing."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"414±0.02"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH  :  I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D12 has a tolerance band of 0.04 mm (≤ 0.1 mm) on a part that receives zinc plating per note N3, yet no allowance for plating thickness is indicated. Plating buildup will push this feature out of its tight tolerance, potentially causing assembly interference; the designer should either widen the pre-plate tolerance by the expected coating thickness or add a note specifying the dimension applies after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a plating-thickness allowance to the pre-plate dimension or explicitly state that the ±0.02 tolerance applies after surface treatment."}]}
